newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Nov skilled vacancies fall 0.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Australia Nov skilled vacancies fall 0.7 pct.

text.p: The Australian government's index of skilled job vacancies fell 0.7 percent in November, the Employment Department said on Thursday.
The index fell to 139, the eleventh consecutive monthly fall and 19.2 percent below the index for the same month in 1995, the department said in a statement.
Falls were recorded for five of the 16 occupational groups, while nine increased and two remained unchanged.
The biggest falls were 4.7 percent in both the vehicle trades and health diagnosis and treatment sectors, while the business professionals sector dropped 4.2 percent.
Natural science rose 3.8 percent and electrical trades lifted 2.8 percent, the department said.
The index was 110.6 percent above the recession low of 66 recorded in mid-1991.
The index measures skilled vacancy advertisements in the major city newspapers on the first Saturday of each month.
